entities.summary: Elif Batuman is an American author, academic, and journalist. She is the author of three books: a memoir, The Possessed (2010), the novel The Idiot (2017), which was a finalist for the 2018 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction, and Either/Or (2022). Batuman is a staff writer for The New Yorker. Elif Batuman was a writers & intellectuals from New York City (b. 1977-06-07, New York City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
